name: agentmart-site-check
description: AgentMart Site Check: one plugin that checks a website's public setup through an MCP server that changes nothing on the sites it checks, with no sign-in.

plugins.name: agentmart-site-check
plugins.description: Checks a website's public setup from the outside (HTTPS and security headers, certificate dates, SPF and DMARC, privacy, terms and contact pages, llms.txt, robots.txt and MCP) through a remote MCP server that changes nothing on the sites it checks, with no sign-in, and returns plain steps to fix each item.
